svg.title: Bare PROJ 9.9.0 cs2cs vs NGS’s NCAT beta
svg.desc: Map of the lower 48 states with Alaska below it at the same scale. Each of the 230 county points is a dot whose colour and size show the horizontal gap between bare PROJ 9.9.0 cs2cs and NCAT. East of 104° W the gap was 9 to 18 cm. West of 104° W it was 10 to 43 cm, with the largest in San Diego County (0.428 m). In Alaska it was 14 cm to 0.92 m, with the largest in the Copper River Census Area (0.921 m). Every point was more than 5 cm from NCAT.
svg.text: Bare PROJ 9.9.0 cs2cs vs NGS’s NCAT beta
Horizontal gap at 230 US county points, October 13, 2026
Bare cs2cs EPSG:6318 EPSG:10968 vs NCAT.
Every point was more than 5 cm from NCAT.
The points are Census county internal points, not survey marks.
Distances are horizontal on the GRS80 ellipsoid.
NCAT and its grids are beta and may change. These numbers
Data: out/results.json in this directory. CyberNative AI LLC.
Boundaries: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 cartographic boundary file, 1:20,000,000.
